**NPU04998 (P-Kreatinin)** is a specific laboratory test code used within the Danish healthcare system to measure serum creatinine levels, which is a key indicator of kidney function [^src1]. In the context of national clinical quality databases, this code plays a critical role in monitoring patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] who are undergoing treatment with [[doac|DOAC]] (direct oral anticoagulants) [^src2]. 

To ensure patient safety and adherence to clinical guidelines, healthcare providers must verify kidney function at least once a year for patients on DOAC therapy [^src1]. NPU04998 is one of the two specific codes designated for this annual monitoring, alongside its alternative, [[npu18016-p-kreatinin|NPU18016 (P-Kreatinin)]] [^src2]. The use of these precise NPU codes allows for standardized data collection and quality measurement across the country [^src3].

Geographically, the NPU04998 code is predominantly utilized in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] [^src3]. The systematic tracking of this laboratory test is part of a broader effort by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to evaluate and improve the quality of diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up care for cardiovascular diseases in Denmark [^src1].
